statistical_caveat: The 10-sample diagnostic study (5 per class) is used strictly for debugging error taxonomy and inspecting failure modes, NOT for estimating population generalization. Each single misclassification shifts class-specific recall by 20 percentage points, and zero observed false acceptances in five negative examples does not establish a negligible population false-acceptance rate.

categories: MISSING_BOX: Missing explicit terminal answer demarcations or boxes.
INFORMAL_INDONESIAN_MARKER: Student conclusions embedded in conversational Indonesian phrasing ('jadi', 'maka', 'toko rugi').
MATH_EQUIVALENCE: LaTeX formatting (\dfrac, \text), fractions vs decimals, and unit notation.
OCR_TRANSCRIPTION_ERROR: OCR line prefix numbering ('L1 |', 'L6 |') or character misrecognition.
AMBIGUOUS_UNREADABLE: Illegible handwriting or conflicting steps -> triggers ABSTAIN.

baseline_regex_normalizer.failure_mode: Failed to strip OCR line headers ('L6 | 80 buku') and unhandled LaTeX fractions (\dfrac{4}{3})

operational_approval_gates: Gate 1 (Accuracy): At least 85% on a preregistered, stratified validation set (N >= 50 or full validation fold).
Gate 2 (Class-Specific Recall): Greater than 50% for both correct and incorrect answers, reported separately.
Gate 3 (Downstream Utility): Statistically significant positive paired out-of-fold MAP@3 delta (10,000 bootstrap resamples, 95% CI > 0, p < 0.05).
Gate 4 (Safety Fallback): Explicit ABSTAIN on unreadable/ambiguous answers; abstentions MUST fallback to unchanged baseline predictions.
Gate 5 (Traceability & Reproducibility): Saved predictions, per-example errors, configurations, and SHA-256 artifact hashes.
governance_decision: Gating remains strictly disabled. Next stage requires evaluating the enhanced normalizer and frontier multilingual VLM on a preregistered, stratified validation set before any downstream test execution.
